Recorded population statistics

Source: R/accessors.R
statistics.Rd

Statistics recorded during evolve(), every record_every generations.

Usage

trait_means(pop)

mean_fitness(pop)

variances(pop)

g_matrices(pop, component = c("total", "genic", "ld"))

p_matrices(pop)

Arguments

pop

an evomod_population.

component

"total" (G), "genic" or "ld".

Value

A data frame or a named list of matrices.

Details

  • trait_means(): mean genotypic value (mean_x), mean phenotype (mean_z) and optimum (theta) of each trait, in long format.

  • mean_fitness(): mean fitness of the population on the fitness surface of the current regime (NA under drift).

  • variances(): additive genetic (G) and phenotypic (P) variances and heritability (h2) of each trait, in long format.

  • g_matrices(), p_matrices(): lists of covariance matrices of genotypic values (G) and phenotypes (P), named by generation. For architectures where genotypic values are sums of allele effects (additive(), binary_b()) G can be split into its genic part, the G expected without linkage disequilibrium (twice the sum over loci of the covariance of allele effects), and the rest, due to linkage disequilibrium between loci and departures from Hardy-Weinberg (component = "ld"); see also g_decomposition().
